patch_description: I replaced the tied even/odd ansatz with a modular, per-qubit Euler-style block that keeps the same 24 trainable circuit parameters per repeat, but improves expressivity and mixing. The new structure uses independent RY and RZ layers, a sparse next-nearest-neighbor CZ pattern, and a small set of long-range CNOT bridges before a final RX layer. This better matches the feature-map-induced correlations, increases entanglement reach without exploding parameter count, and should improve validation/test performance while keeping the circuit efficient and easy to validate.
